current.text: He is the projected starting power forward next to Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cam Johnson and Nikola Jokic.
The depth behind him at power forward is called abysmal.
Denver is expected to be extra cautious with his minutes. He is seen as a streamable player who carries injury risk.

Experts see him as a low-upside late pick. One would not draft him in standard leagues at his Yahoo price of about pick 112 to 119, after he finished 146th in categories. Another calls him a stable round 11 option who is better in deeper leagues.
Last season he turned 77% of his deflections into steals. The league average is 49%.
His steals are more likely to fall than rise.
His injury record makes him a possible trade candidate. One expert expects at least two of last year's Denver starters to be gone by the deadline.
Denver plays 43 games through March 28, one below the most of any team. It has only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league.

durable.text: He has recurring lower-body soft tissue injuries, including repeated hamstring and calf injuries, two years in a row.
Steals and blocks are his weak categories for a forward or center. The rest of his line is close to average with no big outlier.

note: Gordon is a 1 to 2 USD end-of-auction pick for us. He is valued at 1 USD on Yahoo and 0 on ESPN (ranks 124 and 156), and he went for 2 USD in our league last season. He fits punt STL and punt BLK builds as a decent FG% forward with some threes and assists, but he has played only 36 and 51 games in the last two seasons, and experts see no upside. Let others take him. If he goes undrafted, check his minutes and hamstring and calf health early, and use him as a streamer, since Denver has few back-to-backs.
